title: Dialux Lighting Design
description: Design professional indoor and outdoor lighting schemes using Dialux software with lux calculations and 3D visualisation.
fullDescription: Dialux is the industry-standard lighting design software. This course covers room modelling, luminaire selection, lux level calculations, emergency lighting, and generating professional reports for architects and electrical engineers.
whatYouWillLearn: Model rooms and buildings in Dialux
Select and place luminaires from manufacturer databases
Calculate lux levels and uniformity ratios
Design emergency and escape route lighting
